short: The cyclotomic fixed-field condition for a host

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.IsChiField
lean.plain: The cyclotomic fixed-field condition for a host
lean.note: Read the four conditions on $r$ as a membership test for the subgroup fixing the host inside the cyclotomic field. The two quadratic-residue conditions specify the contributions of the auxiliary primes $q$ and $d$ to the field.
